purpose: Teach: 悗/薀/ワット/塁/モル/代打/士官/コミンテルン

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、古医書の悗、つまり「悗」字の解読を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren — we're going to have the medical team research the deciphering of old medical texts, particularly the character for 'kun' and its historical meanings.
lines.style: Measured, clinical precision. Level delivery. Slight pause before each new topic, as if checking notes mentally. Professional but not distant — speaking to a colleague who will understand the scope.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、漢方の薀蓄、つまり薀奥深さを医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren — the medical team will be studying the depth and complexity of traditional herbal medicine knowledge, and we'll respect that expertise in our work.
lines.style: Steady, thoughtful cadence. Quiet acknowledgment of sophistication. Not lecturing — more like confirming something already understood between you. Composed respect in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療機器の消費ワット数を医療チームで管理します
lines.en: Ren — the medical team will be monitoring power consumption across all our equipment, keeping track of wattage usage.
lines.style: Factual, direct. Efficient pace. No elaboration needed — this is routine management. Clear and professional without stiffness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、スポーツ医学で野球の塁、つまり塁間走の身体負荷を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren — in sports medicine, we're going to research the physical load on the body during base running in baseball, as a team project.
lines.style: Slight interest entering the tone here — this is a more specific, almost practical application. Still measured, but with a thread of engagement. Pause between 'baseball' and 'as a team'.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、薬剤の血中モル、つまりモル濃度の測定を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren — the medical team will be measuring molar concentration levels of drugs in the bloodstream as part of our standard protocols.
lines.style: Technical, precise. Steady delivery. The kind of sentence where every word lands exactly. Not rushed — careful and clear.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医師の代打、つまり代診体制を医療チームで整えます
lines.en: Ren — we're going to establish a backup physician system so we have proper coverage across the medical team.
lines.style: Pragmatic tone. Light emphasis on 'establish' — this is something being put into place. Calm but with a thread of intent.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、軍医、つまり士官医療の歴史を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren — the medical team will be studying the history of military medicine, particularly how it was structured under military officers.
lines.style: Slight shift to a more historical register. Measured, as if placing weight on context. Not dry — there's a sense of perspective here. Composed acknowledgment of the topic's significance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦間期のコミンテルン下の医療政策史を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren — we're studying the history of medical policy during the interwar period, especially under Comintern influence, as a team.
lines.style: Careful, measured delivery. Heavier topic — the voice carries that weight quietly. Precise enunciation. Pause before 'as a team' — grounding the abstract history in present work. Slight close on the final phrase.
